components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. On create/update it is accepted as a flat value for backward compatibility; when structured lines are supplied it is the composed, normalized address returned in responses.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: Optional second line of the structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^(\D*\d){10}\D*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, an 'ageBand' is derived from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: Stable shared identifier for owners of the same household (same last name and address), assigned when 'sharesHousehold' is set.
          type: string
          example: '2f1b8c0e-0d3a-3b6e-9f4a-1c2d3e4f5a6b'

## Summary

I implemented the salutation feature with minimal structural impact:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional input field `title` to `OwnerFields` and a read-only output field `salutation` to `Owner`. The DTOs are generated from this spec at build time.

2. **`Person.java`** — added a `@Transient` `title` field with `getTitle()`/`setTitle()`, plus a small `getSalutation()`:
   ```java
   public String getSalutation() {
       return (title == null || title.isEmpty()) ? lastName : title + " " + lastName;
   }
   ```

Why these choices keep structural cost low:
- **No mapper changes.** MapStruct auto-maps by property name: `title` flows `OwnerFieldsDto → Owner` on create, and `getSalutation()`/`getTitle()` flow `Owner → OwnerDto` on read. So I didn't touch the large, high-WMC `OwnerMapper` at all.
- **Placed on `Person`, not `Owner`.** `Person` is a tiny class (four trivial accessors), so the `WMC_other` context surrounding each new method is small — the dominant cost lever stays minimal.
- **`@Transient`, not a new column.** This avoids editing the four DB schema files, and — since `Vet` also extends `Person` — avoids forcing a `title` column onto the `vets` table. Only two files touched (spec + model), each with small, cohesive additions.

The new `salutation` field returns `"DR who"` for a titled owner and just the last name otherwise, as specified.
